theThreeClassesTheDispatchExpectedAndWhe.no-district-on-parcel: IS NOT a class in the store, and this is the dispatch's own instruction to report what the data forces. The no-table branch short-circuits BEFORE the district read, so a parcel with no district on file is written no-ruled-table and nothing in its setback cell says whether it has a district. The condition is real and measurable, but only off the zoningDistrict rail -- so it is measured as the P-300 axis, not asserted as a class.
theThreeClassesTheDispatchExpectedAndWhe.unreadable-source: IS NOT a class either, for the same reason and with the same evidence: the reason the district is missing lives on the zoningDistrict cell (today: 'no tx_zoning_district_staging base layer exists for <city> yet'), and the instrument rolls those reasons into families so the source-absent population is counted rather than described.

theP300RuleAsWritten.ruling: OT-10 (_decisions/2026-09-17_setback_corpus_flag_state_and_default_line_rulings.md, ruling 4): a table may carry one jurisdiction-default row, marked as such and never a district, applied ONLY to that jurisdiction's parcels that have no district; every answer that uses it carries the plat/ordinance disclosure
theP300RuleAsWritten.operationalisation: per parcel, hasDistrict = its zoningDistrict cell is kind 'value' with a non-blank code. No district on file -> a jurisdiction-default row resolves it (jurisdiction-default-servable). A district on file -> the default does not apply, and the real district row is what is missing (needs-real-district-table).
theP300RuleAsWritten.preRegisteredCrossCheck: Gholson is P-300's own first case and its row names 840 parcels. If this lane's Gholson count is not 840, either the ruling's number or this lane's rule is wrong, and both are then reportable. This is the sharpest available outside check on the P-300 definition.

preRegisteredExpectedBands.B1_twoClassesDominant: EXPECT no-ruled-table to dominate (a no-table city is one lookup away and needs no district at all) and district-miss to be the minority. If district-miss dominated, the residual would be about table completeness rather than about jurisdiction acquisition, and the whole remediation shape would change.
preRegisteredExpectedBands.B2_emptyClasses: EXPECT unresolved-raw-code = 0 and never-written = 0. P-256 states unresolved-raw-code measured 0, and the vintage timestamps on the recorded cells suggest every residual cell carries a basis. A non-zero never-written is the interesting result: it would mean parcels nobody has visited since P-256.
preRegisteredExpectedBands.B3_corpusRecheckZeroContradictions: EXPECT 58,339 of 58,339 to re-derive against the installed corpus 1.4.0, because the residual was written hours earlier by the same corpus version. Any contradiction is drift between the recorded cells and the corpus, which is a finding about P-299/P-300's own work.
preRegisteredExpectedBands.B5_railAgreement: EXPECT all five setback rails to carry one fingerprint per parcel across all 981,405 parcels of the six counties. P-256 writes all five rails from one JSON text (buildCellsForEveryRail), so agreement is expected by construction -- and is checked because per-parcel classification is only honest while it holds.

falsifiersPreRegistered.falsifier: 1. Every residual cell re-derives against the write path's own router and table probe: 0 contradictions over 58,339.
falsifiersPreRegistered.preRegisteredAnswer: PASS expected on the corpus re-check (hasRuledTable for every no-ruled-table jurisdiction, resolveSetbackForParcel for every district-miss code, run in-process against @empressaio/setback-corpus@1.4.0, the version the cells themselves record). A contradiction FAILS the class, and the report names the parcels.
falsifiersPreRegistered.howItWillBeEvidenced: corpusRecheck.noTable and corpusRecheck.districtMiss in the measurement artifact, each carrying checked/agrees/contradicts

falsifiersPreRegistered.falsifier: 2. The classes sum to 58,339 and no parcel is in two classes, asserted as an invariant that fails the run.
falsifiersPreRegistered.preRegisteredAnswer: PASS expected. The instrument computes the invariant over the population and sets its own exit code from it (0 only if every invariant holds AND the digest is unchanged), so a failure is a non-zero exit rather than a sentence in a report.
falsifiersPreRegistered.howItWillBeEvidenced: invariants[] in the artifact, including classes-sum-to-population and p300-partition-is-a-partition, plus the process exit code

falsifiersPreRegistered.falsifier: 3. The classifier returns `unclassified` for a fingerprint whose class it does not implement.
falsifiersPreRegistered.preRegisteredAnswer: PASS expected by VIOLATION, never by observation: the test file drives a router fingerprint with a codeClass no rule implements, a fingerprint with an unknown method, and an unaccounted cell carrying a codeClass the writer maps to refused. All three must come back unclassified with a reason, and the third must NOT land in district-miss. The pre-change behaviour is predicted in advance: a classifier that falls through to its last branch would put all three in district-miss, which is the bucket-swallows-everything failure the dispatch names.
falsifiersPreRegistered.howItWillBeEvidenced: test/setback-residual-composition.test.mjs 'VIOLATION: ...' cases, plus unclassified.total in the artifact

falsifiersPreRegistered.falsifier: 4. The store is unchanged by the read.

theDefectThisLaneReadsAndLeaves.what: processCityPage's `if (!city.ruled)` branch runs BEFORE the zoningDistrict read, so for a city with no ruled table the district is never consulted and the setback cells are written no-ruled-table even where the district rail is itself refused or not-applicable upstream. The refused/not-applicable PROPAGATION that P-256 built for ruled cities cannot fire on the 48,825 residual parcels whose district is refused for want of a staging layer.
theDefectThisLaneReadsAndLeaves.evidence: basis.method = 'getSetbackTable(jurisdictionKey) probe' on all 49,855 no-ruled-table cells while 48,825 of those place_keys carry zoningDistrict kind='refused' and 4 carry kind='not-applicable' -- measured in this lane's artifact (upstreamZoning).
theDefectThisLaneReadsAndLeaves.whyItIsNotFixedHere: the dispatch says name it with its evidence and leave it; a separate lane owns the fix. It is also not obviously a defect in the direction a first read suggests: the no-table fact is true and the acquisition need is real either way, so the fix is a question about which fact a cell should carry, not a bug fix.
theDefectThisLaneReadsAndLeaves.consequenceIfItStands: any future remediation that reads the setback cell alone will see 'the city has no table' and miss that the parcel also has no zoning layer, so the two acquisition programmes stay indistinguishable at the cell.
